from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
im = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B=im[...,0],im[...,1],im[...,2]
H,W=R.shape
def cls(p):
    r,g,b=p
    mx=max(p);mn=min(p);sat=mx-mn
    if mx<40: return '#'   # near black
    if sat<25:
        if mx>200: return '.' # white/light
        if mx>120: return '+' # gray
        return ':' # dark gray
    if r>140 and g<95 and b<95 and r-g>60: return 'R'
    if r>170 and 90<g<175 and b<100 and 20<r-g<110: return 'O'
    if r>180 and g>155 and b<120 and r-b>80: return 'Y'
    if g>=r and g>=b: return 'g'
    if b>=r and b>=g: return 'b'
    if r>g>b: return 'o' # brownish
    return '?'
gy,gx=24,32
for j in range(gy):
    row=''
    for i in range(gx):
        y0=j*H//gy;y1=(j+1)*H//gy;x0=i*W//gx;x1=(i+1)*W//gx
        block=im[y0:y1,x0:x1].reshape(-1,3)
        from collections import Counter
        c=Counter(cls(p) for p in block)
        row+=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    print(row)
